article_under_the_sea_adventure.summary: A girl puts on her diving mask and swims down to the coral reef for the very first time. Follow her through the shallow water, the dark blue middle and the reef at the bottom. After reading, you can retell the adventure, use five new sea words in your own sentences, and explain why you should never touch a living coral.
article_under_the_sea_adventure.title: My First Adventure Under the Sea
